cases.candidate_name: Menstrual Cycle Study: Results published in Diabetes Care

claim.text: DCB conducted a clinical study using CGM data from 77 adults with type 1 diabetes.

citations.quote: The Menstrual Cycle Study was conducted in collaboration between Tidepool and the Diabetes Center Berne (DCB). The retrospective decentralized study analysed real-world data donated by 77 menstruating adults with type 1 diabetes using automated insulin delivery systems.
In total, the dataset covered 380 menstrual cycles and 10,107 days of data from continuous glucose monitoring, insulin delivery, carbohydrate intake and menstrual cycle tracking.

cases.label_reason: Joint work supports involvement but not sole authorship or leadership.
